core_problem_solved: To provide a complete, high-performance, and fully compliant implementation of the StAX (Streaming API for XML) and the extended Stax2 APIs for Java.
key_features: A fast and efficient streaming XML parser (reader and writer)
Full compliance with the standard StAX (JSR-173) and extended Stax2 APIs
Robust error handling and validation features
era_and_niche: A legacy Maven coordinate for the Woodstox XML parser, hosted at the now-defunct Codehaus repository. Woodstox is a leading choice for high-performance XML processing.
reason_for_obsolescence: This specific Maven coordinate is **obsolete**. The project moved from Codehaus to the FasterXML organization (the same group behind the Jackson JSON library). The modern and actively maintained successor is **`com.fasterxml.woodstox:woodstox-core`**.
